result.summary: Found 1 visual issue: an overlay/stroke is obscuring the bottom navigation area.

issues.description: A thick dark horizontal bar appears across the bottom navigation, overlapping the search and bookmark icons. It makes the navigation look broken and may interfere with tapping or understanding the nav items.
issues.suggestion: Remove the unintended overlay or reposition any system/home indicator so it sits below the navigation bar and does not cover the icons.
